visualCharacteristics.purpose: serif pull quote with optional attribution, or with a signature image beneath
visualCharacteristics.typography: heading font; signature quote 28/40 centred, 672px wide

contentPattern.structure: row 1: quotation paragraph(s) (quote marks are added automatically); row 2 (optional): attribution text (italic text becomes a cite), or a signature image

usage: Founder quotes on the home and careers pages.
reuseGuidance: Do not type quote marks; they are added. With Signature, put only the signature image (SVG or PNG) in row 2. A row 2 holding only an image is treated as a signature even without the option.
